_doc: Curated alias dictionary: free-text KPIObservation (title, unit) -> canonical indicator id.
Consumed by src/esg_kg/kpi/canonicalize.py (run.py canonicalize), which writes the result to the NEW property
`kpi_id`. It never rewrites `kpi_type`, because kpi_type is part of
KPIObservation.identity_keys and changing it would change node identity.
Why this file exists at all: step01 already emits standard codes for the KPIs it
recognises (484/4906 on AAA), but free text always drifts, so a hand-curated alias layer
is a permanent part of the pipeline - same role issuer_registry.json plays for company
names. Grow `rules` from the `unmapped_titles` list in the step03c stats file.
PRECISION OVER RECALL. The untouched tail is ~85% purely financial KPIs (unit VND / ty
dong), which must NOT be mapped onto a TT96 indicator - that would be a wrong answer, not
a missing one. Anything genuinely ambiguous belongs in `needs_review`, which step03c
deliberately does NOT apply until a human promotes it into `rules`.

rules.note: Headcount, including the education-level breakdown of the workforce.
Gender split of the workforce = diversity, not headcount.
Direct/indirect energy consumption. Cost of energy is NOT consumption - see needs_review.
exact: tiêu hao điện năng cho sản xuất

rules.note: Total water WITHDRAWN/used. Wastewater discharge is a different fact - see needs_review.

exact: tỷ lệ tái chế chất thải
tỷ lệ chất thải tái chế

titles: tổng lượng nước thải phát sinh
needs_review.why_held_back: Nước THẢI (discharge) khác nước SỬ DỤNG (withdrawal). TT96 muc 6.4 chi noi ve tieu thu nuoc; SSCIFC-E4 rong hon nhung cung khong dung han. Map bua se lam sai chi tieu.
Day la CHI PHI (tien) chu khong phai MUC TIEU THU (kWh). Dung lam bang chung cho chi tieu nang luong se sai don vi va sai ban chat.

titles: quy mô sản xuất bao bì màng mỏng
needs_review.why_held_back: San luong san xuat/ban hang la chi tieu kinh doanh, khong phai chi tieu ESG cua TT96. Chi map neu dung lam mau so cuong do phat thai.
